# sherpa-select-card

A selectable card with header / content / footer regions.

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Category | control |
| Figma | Select Card |
| Source | [.ts](../../src/components/sherpa-select-card/sherpa-select-card.ts) · [.html](../../src/components/sherpa-select-card/sherpa-select-card.html) · [.css](../../src/components/sherpa-select-card/sherpa-select-card.css) · [.component.json](../../src/components/sherpa-select-card/sherpa-select-card.component.json) · [.example.json](../../src/components/sherpa-select-card/sherpa-select-card.example.json) |

## Example

```html
<sherpa-select-card data-label="Pro" data-description="For growing teams" name="plan" value="pro" checked>12 seats</sherpa-select-card><sherpa-select-card data-label="Free" data-description="To try it" name="plan" value="free">3 seats</sherpa-select-card>
```

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data-description` | text |  | helper line under the title |
| `data-footer` | `none` |  | none → hide the footer region entirely (CSS-only) |
| `data-label` | text |  | header title (used when no header slot is given) |
| `data-orientation` | `horizontal` `vertical` | `vertical` | vertical \| horizontal (footer beside the body vs below; default vertical) |
| `data-select-mode` | `radio` `checkbox` | `radio` | radio \| checkbox — which footer control shows . checkbox = multi-select (re-click toggles); radio = single-select. |
| `checked` | boolean, native | `false` | present → the card is ticked (also a JS property) |
| `disabled` | boolean, native | `false` | native — dims + blocks interaction |
| `name` | text, native |  | radio group name (default footer) |
| `value` | text, native |  | submitted / reported value when selected |

## Properties

| Property | Type | Access | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `value` | `string` | read and write |  |
| `checked` | `boolean` | read and write | reads and toggles checked |

## Methods

| Method | What it does |
|---|---|
| `focus(options?: FocusOptions)` | Focus its control: the first focusable part inside. |
| `checkValidity()` | Is it acceptable, as its form sees it? |
| `reportValidity()` | Check, and show the browser's message on the control. |
| `formDisabledCallback()` | Inside a disabled `<fieldset>`, as by its own `disabled`. |
| `formResetCallback()` | A form reset puts back its first `checked`. |

## Events

Each one bubbles.

| Event | Detail |
|---|---|
| `change` | `{ checked: boolean; value: string }` |

## Slots

| Slot | Accepts | What it holds |
|---|---|---|
| `header` | content | header region (falls back to data-label / data-description) |
| (default) | content | the card body / content |
| `footer` | content | footer region (falls back to the select controls) |

## Parts

Style these from outside with `::part()`:

`body`, `card`, `description`, `footer`, `footer-control`, `header`, `label`

`{ description?, footer?, label?, orientation?, selectMode? }`

Its declared props by name: `label` sets data-label.
